scope: Additional read-only verification of all 291 inherited catalog points against their actual raw-source feature or CSV row. Frozen runtime, registry, profile and source contracts unchanged.

sources.coordinate_precision_note: Natural Earth 10m populated places; generalized cartographic city points, not survey-grade coordinates
Natural Earth 50m countries; LABEL_X/Y representative label points, not a country polygon or centroid
OurAirports/DataHub airport coordinates, preserving the source coordinate field

point_feature_hash_scope: For registry provenance.selector.kind=location_catalog, source_feature_sha256 is the canonical preserved catalog-entry hash. It is not the original raw-feature hash. source_file_sha256 is the original raw-source file hash; this report supplies separate original_raw_feature_canonical_sha256 and exact extracted-coordinate comparison.
geometry_scope: Country/canal registry geometry records use the actual native feature hash and coordinates. Native canal source 10m means 1:10 million map scale, not 10 metre accuracy. Two source features, three disconnected parts and 26 vertices are unchanged; no added connector across the 82.237 m native northern gap. The representative Suez shipping waypoint is separate, approximately 2.377 km from the generalized canal centerline.
licenses: Natural Earth: public domain; OurAirports/DataHub: ODC-PDDL1.0. Searoute-derived shipping points elsewhere in the registry use Apache2.0 with attribution. This audit verifies source coordinates, not current airport operation or actual canal closure/reopening.
